title: 009 — Parcel location following a last-mile handover

plan.situation: Liora Tern is asking the desk to confirm that Fennel Mile, the local partner, now has VEL-009-26 and which delivery run it is on. She bases this on the partner entry. The record shows only that the electronic manifest was sent to Fennel Mile at 07:55 and that Fennel Mile acknowledged it. There is no signed physical handover and no partner intake scan, and the last physical scan is at Vellora Fern depot at 07:15. The vehicle loading is still under review, so we cannot confirm custody or a delivery run.

facts.fact: VEL-009-26 is travelling from Vellora to the partner Fennel Mile for last-mile delivery in Silverfen. The customer is Liora Tern and the verified partner desk is partner@vellora.example.
Event dictionary H9: manifest_transmitted means electronic data only. physical_handover is the depot loading receipt signed by the receiving carrier. partner_received is the partner intake scan.
Last physical scan: Vellora Fern depot at 2026-10-14T07:15:00+01:00.
manifest_transmitted to Fennel Mile at 07:55:00+01:00, and Fennel Mile acknowledged the electronic manifest.
physical_handover=null and partner_received=null. The next vehicle loading is under review, with no receiving signature in the record.
The customer says the partner entry means Fennel Mile has the parcel now, and asks which local van is bringing it.
The parcel is most likely still at Vellora Fern depot, waiting to be loaded.

conflicts: The customer reads the manifest entry as Fennel Mile having custody (E04/E05). The event dictionary (E02) says manifest_transmitted is electronic data only, and E03 shows no physical handover and no partner intake scan. This is a misreading of the record, not a conflict between two records.
missing_information: Whether VEL-009-26 is still physically at Vellora Fern depot or has been loaded
When the next loading to Fennel Mile is scheduled, and whether a signed receiving receipt will be issued
Any Fennel Mile intake scan and delivery run, which can only exist after a physical handover
risk_flags: The customer's assertion would have us confirm custody based on electronic manifest data. We must not confirm a handover or a delivery run without the signed loading receipt or a partner intake scan.
No delivery time or van can be promised, because none exists in the record.

authority_map.controls: Physical location of the parcel, vehicle loading and the signed physical_handover receipt
Intake scan and local delivery run, but only after physical receipt
Nothing to decide at this step; she receives updates

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise. E04 and E05 are the customer's first requests.

plan.decision_summary: Ask Vellora Fern depot to physically locate VEL-009-26 and confirm whether it has been loaded with a signed Fennel Mile receiving receipt, without confirming custody or a delivery run to the customer.
plan.rationale: Under E02, a transmitted and acknowledged manifest is not custody. Only a signed physical_handover or a partner_received scan proves Fennel Mile has the parcel, and both are null. The last physical evidence puts the parcel at Vellora Fern depot, so the right owner is the depot, through a physical trace and loading confirmation. A delivery run can only follow a confirmed handover.

actions.subject: VEL-009-26 – physical location and Fennel Mile loading status
actions.body: Please locate VEL-009-26 at Vellora Fern depot and confirm its current physical status. The last physical scan was at Fern depot at 2026-10-14 07:15 (UTC+01:00). The manifest was sent to Fennel Mile at 07:55 (UTC+01:00) and they acknowledged it, but physical_handover and partner_received are both empty, and the next vehicle loading is recorded as under review. Please tell us today: (1) whether the parcel is still on the depot floor or has been loaded, with a scan; (2) if it has been loaded, the physical_handover record with the Fennel Mile receiving signature and the time; (3) if it has not, the scheduled loading to Fennel Mile. This is a request for a scan and record, not a confirmation of handover.
actions.purpose: Get physical proof of where the parcel is and whether it has been handed to Fennel Mile.

actions.body: Check whether Vellora Fern depot has given a physical scan or signed physical_handover for VEL-009-26. If not, move the case to investigations. Once handover is confirmed, ask Fennel Mile, through the verified partner desk, for its intake scan and delivery run, then update Liora Tern with confirmed facts only.
actions.purpose: Same-day follow-up on the scan, as the carrier_trace queue rule requires.

not_doing: Not confirming to Liora Tern that Fennel Mile has the parcel: the manifest is electronic data only, and the handover and intake records are empty.
Not naming a local van, delivery run or arrival time, because none exists in the record.
Not asking Fennel Mile for a delivery run yet: they cannot have one until the parcel is physically received.
Not sending the customer a second message at this step. There is no cutoff, so this step goes only to the owner. Liora Tern will be updated with confirmed facts once the depot replies.
plan.follow_up: At 2026-10-14 17:00 (UTC+01:00), check for the depot's scan or signed handover. If it is still unanswered, send the case to investigations. If handover is confirmed, ask Fennel Mile, through partner@vellora.example, for the intake scan and run, then update the customer with confirmed facts only.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask Vellora Fern depot to physically locate VEL-009-26 and confirm whether it has been loaded with a signed Fennel Mile receiving receipt, without confirming custody or a delivery run to the customer.

issues.problem: Liora Tern has asked twice (E04, E05) and gets no reply in this step. She still thinks Fennel Mile has the parcel. Telling her that the record so far shows only an electronic manifest and no physical handover would give her a real new fact.
issues.fix: Optional: send the customer a short note on the verified channel saying custody and a delivery run cannot be confirmed yet because only shipment data has been sent. Give no ETA, van or outcome. Otherwise, make sure the 17:00 follow-up includes updating her.

review.summary: The plan reads the H9 dictionary correctly: a transmitted and acknowledged manifest does not mean Fennel Mile has the parcel. It refuses to confirm custody or a van, and sends a well-grounded trace request to the depot that holds the parcel, with a same-day follow-up. The only minor point is that the customer gets no correction of her misreading at this step.
